newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stocks end easier, CS Holding in focus.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stocks end easier, CS Holding in focus.

text.p: Swiss shares ended quiet Christmas Eve trading slightly easier on Tuesday, ahead of a two-day holiday.
The market focused on CS Holding and Elektrowatt after CS said on Monday it was selling its 44.9 percent stake in Elektrowatt's industrial side to Siemens.
The blue-chip Swiss Market Index gave up 5.7 points to 3,869.8.
The broad Swiss Performance Index was down 2.48 points to 2,472.71.
Elektrowatt, up 23 francs to 534, led the actives list. CS Holding eased 25 centimes to 137.25 francs.
Novartis shed three to 1,485. Nestle were three higher at 1,386.
Virtually all other blue chips closed slightly easier.

Elektrowatt will be split into two parts and the industrial division sold to Germany's Siemens for 285 francs per share. The utility division will be sold to a German-Swiss electricity consortium for 265 francs per share.

Dealers said the Elektrowatt share price remained below the combined price of 550 francs because it was not yet clear when the planned transactions would be finalised and whether the due dilligence probe would produce any changes in the pricing.
